title: Dubai private villas and townhouses

authorities.document: Dubai Building Code 2021, Part K Villas
UAE Fire & Life Safety Code of Practice (CDGH-OP-25)
ASHRAE 62.2 Ventilation and IAQ in Residential Buildings

assumptions: Gas: all-electric unless the plan declares gas (LPG rules then apply).
Plot: when the plan has no plot or setbacks, DBC Table K.1 defaults apply (villa 3 m road / neighbour / sikka; townhouse 3 / 0 / 3 m).
Door widths in the plan are clear widths.
Room sizes are measured clear, inside wall faces.

results.title: Living space minimum size
results.requirement: Living spaces (bedroom, living room, etc.): net area >= 10.5 m2 and clear length and width >= 3.0 m.

results.title: Housekeeper's / guard room minimum size
results.requirement: Housekeeper's or guard room (single occupancy, without toilet): net area >= 5.5 m2 and clear length and width >= 2.1 m.

results.title: Enclosed kitchen minimum size
results.requirement: Enclosed kitchen: net area >= 5.4 m2 and clear length and width >= 1.8 m.

results.title: Kitchen manoeuvring space
results.requirement: Manoeuvring space between kitchen counters, or in front of a single-sided counter, >= 1.2 m.

results.title: Minimum clear heights
results.requirement: Clear height >= 2.7 m in living and bedroom spaces, >= 2.3 m in any other space and staircases, >= 2.03 m in non-habitable rooms under stairs.

results.title: Door clear width
results.requirement: Door clear width >= 915 mm for entry doors in general and >= 710 mm for bathrooms and toilets.

items.label: Door Family corridor → Family living & dining

results.title: Window glazing area (bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens)
results.requirement: Net glazing area >= 10% of the floor area of bedrooms, living rooms and kitchens (or daylight modelling achieving >= 150 lux).
results.estimate: Estimate with the engine's default window height (1.2 m, gross opening, not net glazing; target 10%): Majlis 25%, Kitchen 15%, Family living & dining 6%, Bedroom 4 27%, Bedroom 3 16%, Bedroom 2 16%, Master bedroom 19%.

results.title: Housekeeper's room glazing
results.requirement: Housekeeper's rooms: net glazing area >= 8% of the room floor area.
results.estimate: Estimate with the engine's default window height (1.2 m, gross opening, not net glazing; target 8%): Maid room 16%.

results.title: Window sill height
results.requirement: Window sill >= 900 mm above the interior finished floor level.

results.title: Window operator height
results.requirement: Windows with mechanical opening means: operator between 900 mm and 1,500 mm above FFL.
results.note: No windows with mechanical opening means declared (give operator_h for those that have them).

results.title: Room depth for natural light
results.requirement: Room depth should not exceed 3 x the width of the wall with the window; otherwise add a window on another side.

results.title: Access to views
results.requirement: Direct line of sight to the outdoor environment from habitable spaces.

results.title: Hallway and corridor width
results.requirement: Hallways and corridors: clear width >= 1.0 m and clear headroom >= 2.3 m.

results.title: Maximum building height
results.requirement: Total building height (road edge level at main access to average roof finish) <= 16 m.

results.title: Building setbacks
results.requirement: Setbacks per DCR / affection plan; when not defined: villa 3 m from road, neighbour and sikka; townhouse 3 / 0 / 3 m.

results.title: Distance between buildings on a plot
results.requirement: Standalone villas: >= 1.5 m between multiple buildings on the same plot.

results.title: Annexes
results.requirement: Annex >= 1.5 m from the main villa (may attach in townhouses), area <= 60% of main building GA, height <= 5.5 m.

results.title: Guardrails
results.requirement: Guardrail >= 1,200 mm where a floor is more than 760 mm above FFL; no 100 mm sphere passes.
results.note: Single-level plans have no raised floors, balconies or roofs.

results.title: Parking
results.requirement: At least 1 parking bay per villa or townhouse within the plot (unless the DCR differs); parking slope <= 4%.

results.title: Garage minimum dimensions
results.requirement: Garage clear width x length >= 3.0 x 5.5 m (single, open), 3.6 x 6.0 m (single, enclosed), 6.0 x 6.0 m (double, enclosed).

results.title: Screening of outdoor equipment
results.requirement: Outdoor mechanical equipment should be concealed from public view by walls, screens, fences, parapets or landscape.

results.title: Townhouse party wall
results.requirement: Townhouses: 2 h fire-rated wall to adjacent townhouses from foundation to roof (1 h if sprinkler protected).

results.title: Floor drains in wet areas
results.requirement: Floor drains in all areas containing wet sanitary fittings or appliances (kitchens, toilets, showers, ablution areas).

results.title: Floor drain trap seal
results.requirement: Each floor drain receives a fitting's waste or AC condensate (or has a trap primer); >= 75 mm water seal; bidets connect to the stack, not a floor drain; floor drains not chained.

results.title: Cold water storage tank
results.requirement: Tank sized for >= 24 h demand (villas typically 250-350 l/day); GRP; installed in a conditioned space, not exposed outdoors.

results.title: Hot water supply
results.requirement: Hot water supplied to basins, sinks, showers and baths; stored >= 60 C; 50 C at outlets within 1 min; pumped return unless trace heating.
results.note: Checks that a water heater exists; temperatures and return loop are design notes for the reviewer.

results.title: Hot water outlet temperatures
results.requirement: Thermostatic mixing valves: shower 41 C, wash basin 38-41 C, bath 44 C maximum.
results.note: Specification item, not shown on a plan.

results.clause: DBC K.10.5.2; FLSC Ch.8 Table 8.13 item 26
results.title: Smoke detection and alarm system
results.requirement: Every villa / townhouse has a smoke detection and alarm system (wired per Ch.8 Section 4.3, or wireless per Section 4.11).

items.label: Villa
items.limit: smoke detection system with a panel

results.title: Detectors in bedrooms, living rooms and corridors
results.requirement: Bedroom: sounder-based smoke detector; living room: smoke detector; corridor: smoke detector.

results.title: Closed kitchen detector
results.requirement: Closed kitchen: detector listed for kitchens, or a heat detector.

results.title: Open kitchen detector
results.requirement: Open kitchen: listed kitchen detector, or heat detector plus a smoke detector 3 m from the counter in the living room, or a listed kitchen multisensor.

results.title: Fire alarm panel location
results.requirement: The fire alarm control panel or monitoring panel is located near the front door.

results.clause: DBC K.10.5.2; FLSC Table 8.13 item 26 iv
results.title: Outdoor audio-visual notification
results.requirement: Audio-visual notification devices outside the villa, visible from the common approach road.

results.title: Hassantuk connection
results.requirement: The villa fire alarm system is connected to DCD control centres through Hassantuk for Homes.

results.title: Sprinklers and hose reels threshold
results.requirement: Sprinklers in every room and hose reels are required when the ground floor GA > 1,500 m2 (or a basement GA > 1,500 m2).
results.note: Sprinklers and hose reels not required.

results.title: Two exits for large floors
results.requirement: Where any floor of the villa exceeds 400 m2, two primary means of escape remote from each other are provided.
results.note: Floor area is not above 400 m².

results.title: Door hardware
results.requirement: Bathroom doors openable from outside in an emergency when locked; closet latches openable from inside; no locking that impedes egress while occupied.

results.title: Hallway width (FLSC)
results.requirement: Hallway >= 915 mm wide with clear headroom >= 2,030 mm (DBC K-13 at 1.0 m is stricter and governs).

results.title: Kitchen fire extinguisher
results.requirement: Home kitchen: one multipurpose dry-powder extinguisher (2.5 kg) inside the kitchen next to the exit door.

items.label: Kitchen
items.value: extinguisher 0.916 m from a kitchen door
items.limit: extinguisher inside the kitchen next to the exit door

results.title: LPG cylinders
results.requirement: LPG cylinders are not permitted indoors (unless DCD agrees; then FLSC Ch.11 Table 11.2).

results.title: Distribution board location
results.requirement: DBs not installed in bathrooms or toilets, damp or wet locations, bedrooms, kitchens, above sinks, store rooms, hot or hazardous rooms, or below a staircase.

items.label: DB in Mech
items.limit: not in bath, wet area, bedroom, kitchen, store, above sink

results.title: DB mounting height and access
results.requirement: DB top <= 2 m above FFL; access available at all times.
needs: DB mounting height to the top (top_h)

results.title: Socket outlets
results.requirement: 13 A BS 1363 shuttered, switched socket outlets; 15 A to BS 546; IP55 outdoors; shaver outlets to BS EN 61558 in bathrooms.

results.title: Accessory mounting heights
results.requirement: Switches, AC / water heater DP switches and shaver outlets 1.25 m above FFL; general 13 A sockets 450 mm; kitchen sockets 150 mm above the worktop.

results.title: Kitchen socket positions
results.requirement: No socket within 300 mm of the sink edge; no sockets or accessories above gas or electric hobs.

results.title: Sockets per circuit
results.requirement: Radial final circuit: at most five 13 A sockets on a 20 A breaker; ring circuit: at most ten sockets on a 30 A breaker (rooms other than kitchen).

results.title: Cooker control unit
results.requirement: Cooker control switch (BS 4177) separate from the appliance and within 2 m of it, on its own final circuit through a 100 mA ELCB.

items.label: Range in Kitchen
items.value: switch 0.737 m away; dedicated circuit, 100 mA

results.title: Water heater and washing machine control
results.requirement: Own final circuit, DP switch with neon and flex outlet; a water heater in a bathroom or WC has its switch immediately outside the room; heater circuits on 30 mA RCCB/ELCB.

items.label: Washer in Laundry
items.value: DP switch adjacent, own circuit, 30 mA
items.limit: DP switch + flex outlet adjacent (bath heaters: outside the room), own circuit, heaters 30 mA

items.label: Water heater in Mech
items.value: DP switch adjacent, own circuit, 30 mA
items.limit: DP switch + flex outlet adjacent (bath heaters: outside the room), own circuit, heaters 30 mA

results.title: Air-conditioning unit circuits
results.requirement: Each room AC unit on its own final circuit with an adjacent DP switch and flex outlet; minimum 20 A breaker and 4 mm2 wiring.

items.label: Furnace / AHU in Mech
items.limit: own circuit >= 20 A, >= 4 mm2, DP switch adjacent

items.label: AC condenser
items.limit: own circuit >= 20 A, >= 4 mm2, DP switch adjacent

items.label: AC condenser
items.limit: own circuit >= 20 A, >= 4 mm2, DP switch adjacent

results.title: Earth leakage ratings
results.requirement: RCD/ELCB: 13 A sockets, water heaters, dishwashers, fridges, washers, domestic pumps 30 mA; window/split AC, FCU/AHU and cookers 100 mA; general lighting 30/100 mA.

results.title: Lighting circuit loading
results.requirement: Lighting and fan circuits <= 2,000 W, 2.5 mm2 LSF copper, <= 16 A breaker; 100 W per point if fittings are not selected.
results.note: Load calculations are planned for a later version.

results.title: Whole-dwelling ventilation rate
results.requirement: Mechanical outdoor air Qtot = 0.15 x floor area (m2) + 3.5 x (bedrooms + 1) L/s.

results.title: Local exhaust in kitchens and bathrooms
results.requirement: A local mechanical exhaust system in each kitchen and bathroom.

results.title: Demand-controlled exhaust rates
results.requirement: Bathroom 25 L/s; kitchen vented range hood 50 L/s (other kitchen exhaust fans 150 L/s or 5 ach for enclosed kitchens).

results.title: Continuous exhaust rates
results.requirement: Bathroom 10 L/s; enclosed kitchen 5 ach based on kitchen volume.

results.title: Natural ventilation not relied upon
results.requirement: Natural ventilation through windows and doors is permitted but shall not be relied upon for ventilation and thermal comfort.

results.title: Bathroom fan interlock
results.requirement: Bathroom / toilet extract fans controlled through the light switch, timers or sensors.

results.title: Kitchen range hood ducting
results.requirement: Range hoods discharge outdoors through smooth, airtight metal ducts with a backdraft damper, unless ductless with other mechanical ventilation provided.
